ruleName: Playing the ball as it lies
group: Playing the ball as it lies
title: When must you NOT play the ball as it lies?
question: Which situation means you are NOT allowed to play the ball as it lies?

choices.text: The ball is out of bounds
The ball is on the wrong green
The ball is in a no play zone, like a protected young tree area

explanation: You must not play a ball as it lies if it is out of bounds, on the wrong green, or in a designated no play zone. In these cases, you must take relief or apply the relevant rule.
imagePrompt: A teen boy golfer, right-handed, standing near his ball which is inside a roped-off no play zone clearly marked with a sign. He looks unsure of what to do.
imageAlt: A boy golfer near a ball in a protected area marked as no play zone.

issues: Posture does not strongly indicate left-handedness, although the absence of a club minimizes this issue.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Slightly adjust the golfer's stance or hand position to imply she is left-handed, even though no club is present, for increased clarity.
